records.subject: spec-guard-native-codex-desktop-wake
evidence: host:a fresh user-authorized Codex Desktop task registered one exact temporary native identity, completed its initial turn, and became idle
result:a direct Claude message changed the wake receipt to read and created a new Codex turn without a human message in the target task
result:the Codex task read and acknowledged the message, replied to the exact Claude sender, and returned to idle; Claude read and acknowledged the reply
cleanup:the exact temporary Codex task was archived and its native identity retired after unread reached zero

limit:a separate app-server delegation task was not a valid idle-host proof: once notLoaded, its wake remained pending/offline until handled explicitly; this probe is excluded from the passing Desktop result
